name: gold-forecast-agent
description: A daily AI agent that forecasts gold price movement by analyzing news sentiment, mining stock performance, forex rates, and silver prices.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npx tsx --test test_gold_forecast.ts test_adaptive.ts
scripts.test:long: npm run typecheck && RUN_LONG_TESTS=1 npx tsx --test test_gold_forecast.ts test_adaptive.ts
scripts.deploy: npm run build && sam deploy --stack-name goldforecast-stack --region us-east-1 --capabilities CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM --no-confirm-changeset --resolve-s3
